description: Opens a customer dictionary as a sheet in the work screen, so that the people can see it and the work screen can apply it. Columns of every kind: FIND (as written; for MODE regex a JavaScript regular expression), MODE (text or regex; text ignores full-width or half-width, case and spaces), TO, NOTE (why). alias: TO is the name in Maximo ($1 for regex groups); use with dictionaries in match_sheets and lookups. code: FIND is a word in the text, FIELD the field (for example PROBLEM, CAUSE, REMEDY), TO the code, SCOPE optional values of the row (for example failure classes, comma separated) the entry is limited to; use with classify in apply_rule. value: COLUMN optional column name, TO the correct value; use with replace in apply_rule. Add entries with add_rows, change them with patch_cells and remove them with delete_rows, each with a reason. Keep entries narrow and general (no unit numbers that differ from row to row). Entries are not shared until the user presses Save in the work screen: when you have added entries, tell the user to check them and press Save. Changes to a dictionary never go to Maximo.
name: open_dictionary
title: Open a customer dictionary
